Title: Use multifactor authentication
Weakness: MFA not implemented for any accounts
Corrective Action: Deploy Microsoft Authenticator for all users; Configure Azure AD Conditional Access

Title: Implement cryptographic mechanisms
Corrective Action: Enable BitLocker on all workstations; Implement TDE on SQL databases

Title: Employ FIPS-validated cryptography
Corrective Action: Configure FIPS mode on Windows servers; Update applications to use FIPS-validated libraries

Title: Monitor information systems
Corrective Action: Deploy Microsoft Defender for Endpoint; Configure SIEM logging

Title: Limit unsuccessful logon attempts
Corrective Action: Enable account lockout policy in AD (5 attempts / 15 minutes)

Title: Protect audit information
Weakness: Audit logs not protected from modification
Corrective Action: Implement WORM storage for audit logs; Enable log integrity checking

Title: Establish security configuration settings
Corrective Action: Apply CIS benchmarks to all systems; Document deviations
